scope: Actual pinned PDFium, LibreOffice and English Tesseract in a baked network-disabled, read-only, non-root container. Synthetic real PDF/PPTX rendering, scanned text OCR, hidden slide/image composition and malformed/external-resource denial. Real local authenticated upload, malware scan, private S3, Temporal extraction, PostgreSQL/RLS, source-backed Correct/Wrong/Edit and approved memory, including an image-only PDF. OCR fallback covers pages without native text; full document visual persistence/model interpretation, mixed-page OCR, broader languages and deployed/live acceptance remain incomplete.
